name: PDF Reader
description: A local page-by-page PDF reader app with selectable text and agent-powered translation for highlighted passages.

commands.title: Translate selected PDF text
commands.description: Translate only the selected PDF passage into the requested target language using the saved Text Translation Agent.

commands.title: Explain selected PDF text simply
commands.description: Explain only the selected PDF passage in simple language, with an example if useful, using the requested target language and the saved Simple Text Explainer agent.
